7.5.4 Production Errors
This functional cluster does not define any production errors (i.e., Diagnostic Events).
7.6 Access Control
The generation of security events, modification of context data, and interaction over any
ara::diag interface is subject to access control, i.e., it can be restricted which processes
can perform these tasks.
